name: Custom Entity Id
description: Adds a field on the entity-create form that lets a privileged user set a custom numeric entity ID.
project_description: Custom Entity Id adds an 'Entity Id' textfield to the create form of selected fieldable entity types and bundles, letting an authorised user assign a specific numeric primary-key ID to a new entity instead of accepting the database auto-increment value. An administrator picks which entity-type/bundle combinations expose the field on the module settings page (route custom_entity_id.settings). The field is only shown to users holding the 'custom_entity_id access' permission and only for entities that do not yet have an ID (i.e. new entities). On validation the entered value must be numeric and must not collide with an existing row in the entity base table; on presave the value is written into the entity's id key. This is useful when downstream logic keys off specific IDs, when migrating/mirroring content between environments and IDs must be preserved, or when theming per specific entity ID.
